description: This file defines the EntityFormDisplay class in Drupal, which manages the display configuration for entity forms, including methods for collecting display configurations, building forms, validating, and handling widget plugins.

classes.name: EntityFormDisplay
classes.description: Manages the display configuration for entity forms in Drupal, including methods for retrieving, building, and validating form displays, as well as managing widget plugins.

methods.name: collectRenderDisplay
methods.description: Collects and returns the appropriate display object for rendering an entity form based on entity, form mode, and fallback options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the plugin manager and parent class.

methods.name: getRenderer
methods.description: Retrieves the widget renderer for a specific field, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form array for the entity, generating form elements for each widget component.

methods.name: processForm
methods.description: Assigns weights and hides extra fields in the form based on display configuration.

methods.name: extractFormValues
methods.description: Extracts form values from the submitted form into the entity.

methods.name: validateFormValues
methods.description: Validates the entity's form values and flags violations.

methods.name: flagWidgetsErrorsFromViolations
methods.description: Flags widget errors based on validation violations.

methods.name: movePropertyPathViolationsRelativeToField
methods.description: Adjusts violation property paths to be relative to a specific field.

methods.name: getPluginCollections
methods.description: Returns plugin collections for widgets used in the form display.
